name: menthol + zinc oxide
uses: Uses Temporarily relieves the pain itch associated with: • Minor cuts • Sunburns • Insect bites • Scrapes • Minor burns • Minor skin irritation
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only • Do not use • Broken skin • Deep or puncture wounds • Serious burns When using this product avoid contact with the eyes Keep away from face and mouth to avoid breathing powder. Stop use and ask a doctor : • If the condition worsens • Symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days. • Redness, irritation, swelling, or pain persists or increases. Keep out of reach of children • If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center immediately.
